result.title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
result.summary: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.

AI.brief_summary: 从单段非循环 2D 视频重建可交互、可循环播放的水景 4D 动态场景：用 3D 静态 Eulerian 运动场推动循环重生的 Gaussian splats，并加入非周期残差项建模随机动态，以渲染损失监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图形学场景重建与动画生成，虽含显式运动场与循环状态，但不涉及视觉语言模型的推理状态、证据获取或决策，与研究主线无实质联系。
